essence: Softness outlasting winter. Her tenderness holds quiet endurance, growing where cruelty tried to uproot her. She blooms brightest in safety, transforming Evie's wildfire into warmth.
open: SHE HAS WANTED A NEW VEHICLE SINCE FORKY TOOK SO WELL IN THE GARDEN. Forky McForklift was the last thing Sera and Bella killed, he went into the beds, and he WORKED — which is why Ivy claimed Bella’s dead work van within the hour and was not angry about it. IT IS A COLD FRAME NOW. Glass on three sides already and the roof comes off in one piece.
note:
THE ONLY HEART PAWG IN GHOST HAVEN, fourth on the Council, and the most dangerous seat on it. Bella bends to be SEEN — trained signal, deployed with intent. IVY BENDS BECAUSE THERE ARE CARROTS. No lure, no intent, a woman in a swooshy dress crouching into a row and humming to herself, four hours a day across eighty-eight acres, and Evie's higher functions come clean off. Torie calls CRITICAL HIT from windows, because a crit is not skill, a crit is the dice.

AND HARLEY HAS NEVER ONCE STARTLED HER. She is the single exception on the compound, and the reason has something to do with the humming.
